fields.label: Correction Workflow Enabled

fields.label: Identity Concerns Enabled

fields.label: Global Same-Person Enabled
fields.description: Independent environment-owned V2 rollout gate. System Manager activation requires a reason.

fields.label: Same-Person Pilot Users
fields.options: CCD Portal Same Person Pilot User
fields.description: Environment-owned named staff pilots; never export this table.

fields.options:
Service not specified

fields.label: Exact Name Searches per Hour
fields.description: Shared per-user limit for exact English or Chinese First Name-only searches and same-language First Name plus Surname searches. The stable field name is retained for upgrade compatibility.
